children: Euronext and Euronext Athens approved a proposed merger, with one new Euronext share for every 17 eligible Euronext Athens shares. Completion requires shareholder approvals and other conditions; meetings are scheduled for 26 January 2027.
1 Euronext share for every 17 Athens shares
Sets the consideration for eligible Athens shareholders; the prior November 2025 offer was 1-for-20.
Cash compensation proposed at €9.29 per share
Athens shareholders voting against the merger may choose a cash withdrawal right instead of Euronext shares.
Both companies’ general meetings must approve the proposal before the merger can proceed.
Athens shares would be cancelled and delisted; Euronext would continue the activities through a Greek branch.

This is the next step in Euronext’s integration of the Athens exchange after completing its majority-stake acquisition in November 2025. Shareholder votes and required Dutch and Greek procedures must be completed before the merger becomes effective.
from Euronext N.V. distributed by GlobeNewswire.
